headword: {瞬間接着剤|しゅんかんせっちゃくざい}
reading: しゅんかんせっちゃくざい

definitions.gloss: instant adhesive; super glue; instant-bonding glue
definitions.explanation: A type of adhesive that bonds surfaces together very quickly, typically within seconds. The most common type is cyanoacrylate-based adhesive.

examples.japanese: {瞬間接着剤|しゅんかんせっちゃくざい}で{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I fixed it with super glue.

examples.japanese: {瞬間接着剤|しゅんかんせっちゃくざい}が{指|ゆび}にくっついてしまった。
examples.english: The super glue stuck to my fingers.

examples.japanese: {割|わ}れた{花瓶|かびん}を{瞬間接着剤|しゅんかんせっちゃくざい}で{修理|しゅうり}しようとしたが、うまくくっつかなかった。
examples.english: I tried to repair the broken vase with super glue, but it didn't stick well.

notes:
Composed of {瞬間|しゅんかん} (instant, moment) and {接着剤|せっちゃくざい} (adhesive). The most well-known brand in Japan is {アロンアルファ|あろんあるふぁ} (Aron Alpha).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {瞬間接着剤|しゅんかんせっちゃくざい}でくっつける (to glue with instant adhesive)
- {瞬間接着剤|しゅんかんせっちゃくざい}で{修理|しゅうり}する (to repair with super glue)
- {瞬間接着剤|しゅんかんせっちゃくざい}が{固|かた}まる (super glue hardens)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {瞬間接着剤|しゅんかんせっちゃくざい}: instant adhesive (bonds in seconds)
- {接着剤|せっちゃくざい}: adhesive, glue (general term)
- {木工用|もっこうよう}ボンド: wood glue (slower-drying, for woodwork)
